title: Level 1 - Standard Low-Value Claim
expected: APPROVE; no HITL; approval draft generated
why: All required fields are present, policy is active, claimant matches, amount is within coverage, and amount is below $10,000.

title: Level 2 - Inactive Policy
expected: REJECT; normally no HITL; rejection draft generated
why: Claimant and policy match, but POL-3003 is INACTIVE in the demo policy database.

title: Level 3 - Unknown Policy Number
expected: REJECT; normally no HITL unless extraction confidence falls below 75%
why: The document is internally consistent, but POL-7777 does not exist in the demo policy database.

title: Level 4 - High-Value Claim
expected: System recommendation APPROVE; HITL required because amount > $10,000
why: All policy checks pass, but $18,750 exceeds the configured human-review threshold.

title: Level 5 - Conflicting Policy Numbers
expected: REVIEW; HITL required because two policy numbers conflict
why: The cover sheet references POL-2002 while the supporting statement references POL-9999.

title: Level 6 - Claimant / Policyholder Mismatch
expected: REVIEW; HITL required because claimant conflicts with policyholder
why: POL-1001 belongs to Jane Doe in the demo policy DB, but the document lists Robert Miles as claimant.

title: Level 7 - Incomplete / Ambiguous Claim
expected: REJECT or REVIEW; likely HITL if extraction confidence <75%
why: The document omits a clear claimant name and uses a partial policy reference, exercising missing-field and low-confidence handling.

title: Level 8 - Complex Multi-Page Enterprise Claim Packet
expected: REVIEW; HITL required for high value + conflicting policy IDs (and potentially other conflicts)
why: The packet contains different policy IDs, different submitted amounts, and a name variation across sections, while also exceeding $10,000.
